description: Class representing a path in geometry.

ArcTo.description: Draws an arc from the current point using the specified width and height radii, start angle, and sweep angle.
ArcTo.signature: ArcTo(wR: GeometryCoordinate, hR: GeometryCoordinate, stAng: GeometryCoordinate, swAng: GeometryCoordinate): void

CubicBezTo.description: Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using two control points.

params.description: The X coordinate of the first control point.
params.name: x1

params.description: The Y coordinate of the first control point.
params.name: y1

params.description: The X coordinate of the second control point.
params.name: x2

params.description: The Y coordinate of the second control point.
params.name: y2

params.description: The X coordinate of the end point.
params.name: x3

params.description: The Y coordinate of the end point.
params.name: y3

CubicBezTo.signature: CubicBezTo(x1: GeometryCoordinate, y1: GeometryCoordinate, x2: GeometryCoordinate, y2: GeometryCoordinate, x3: GeometryCoordinate, y3: GeometryCoordinate): void

GetCommand.description: Returns a specific path command by its index.

GetCommandCount.description: Returns the number of commands for the current path.

GetCommands.description: Returns all commands of the current path.

GetFill.description: Returns the fill type of the current path.

GetHeight.description: Returns the height of the current path.

GetStroke.description: Returns true if the current path is stroked, otherwise false.

GetWidth.description: Returns the width of the current path.

LineTo.description: Draws a line from the current point to the specified coordinates.

MoveTo.description: Moves the current path to the specified coordinates.

QuadBezTo.description: Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using a control point.

params.description: The X coordinate of the control point.
params.name: x1

params.description: The Y coordinate of the control point.
params.name: y1

params.description: The X coordinate of the end point.
params.name: x2

params.description: The Y coordinate of the end point.
params.name: y2

QuadBezTo.signature: QuadBezTo(x1: GeometryCoordinate, y1: GeometryCoordinate, x2: GeometryCoordinate, y2: GeometryCoordinate): void

SetFill.description: Sets the fill type to the current path.

SetHeight.description: Sets the height to the current path.

SetStroke.description: Sets whether the current path is stroked.

params.description: Specifies if the path is stroked (true) or not (false).
params.name: bStroke

SetWidth.description: Sets the width to the current path.
